name: Pacification Ward
disable: DC 36 Thievery check (master) to block the rune's spray; or Dispel Magic (7th rank, counteract DC 34)

items.name: Tranquilize
items.text:
Trigger A creature Forces Open the gate, fails to Pick the Lock, or damages the gate

---
Effect The rune sprays a mist in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area become pacified, based on the result of their DC 36 Will save save. All effects last until the creature takes a full night's rest or the effect is counteracted with a 4th-rank Clear Mind spell.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –1 status penalty to initiative.

Failure The creature takes a –2 status penalty to initiative and a –1 status penalty to attack rolls and the DCs of spells that target enemies.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature can't use hostile actions against another creature unless that creature uses a hostile action against it first.

text: A barely visible rune on the gate lock sprays nearby creatures with a soporific mist.
